Lao Movie Subtitles

Machine-translated Lao .srt files for 793 films

Please read before downloading

These subtitles are translated by a local machine-translation model. No human has reviewed these files. "Subtitles" files were translated from real English subtitle files by a newer version of the model (NLLB-200 1.3B with the LoRA adapter S3X), with no cloud AI step and no find-and-replace rule tables. An earlier automatic review step, used only for the older "Translated screenplay" files, also sent lines to a cloud AI service (Google Gemini) and applied some of its edits to the Lao; those files are being replaced by real subtitle files as they arrive, and this step is not used for "Subtitles" files at all. The model was fine-tuned mostly on machine-translated text, including earlier output of this project and corrections written by Google Gemini; only a small share of its training data was translated by people. Errors, stiff or unnatural phrasing, and occasional mistranslations are expected -- this is machine output, not a professional or community human translation.

This catalog has two kinds of file. "Subtitles" are timed to a specific film's real dialogue and are machine-translated, not reviewed by a person. "Translated screenplays" are a screenplay, sometimes only an excerpt, translated to Lao with synthetic, evenly-spaced timing (not synced to any actual film) -- useful to read, not to play alongside a video.

If you find a bad line, please use the "🚩 Report a bad line" link on that movie's card to open a GitHub issue.

🎬 793 Movies Localized
💬 1,016,281 Cues Translated
⚡ RTX 5090 GPU Accelerated

Lao subtitles for most films are hard or impossible to find on the major subtitle sites. This public repository bridges that gap using modern local neural translation fine-tuned on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090.

🏆 How We Verify Quality Machine-Checked

The numbers below are about the older "Translated screenplay" files only. Each of those was re-translated fresh and compared against the published line, and a correction was written only when it passed both a set of filters for known failure patterns and a semantic-equivalence check -- never either one alone. For that second check the candidate Lao line is translated back into English by a separate reverse-direction model, and a local LLM running on the project's own computer is asked only whether the two English sentences mean the same thing; it is never shown any Lao. No human reviewed any of it.

"Subtitles" files (S3X) are checked differently: the model's loaded weights are verified against the adapter file on disk, every line's timing is checked against its English source file, every line is confirmed non-empty, credit and ad lines are removed, and the same automatic defect-pattern checks are run against the translated text. They are not re-translated a second time and compared, so none of the numbers below cover them. No quality score is published for these files -- no native Lao reader has reviewed them yet.

Every number below is counted over one set: the 189 "Translated screenplay" films still published here, 189 of this catalogue's 793 films. They are re-summed for this build from the run's own per-film state file, lao_nlp/data/metadata_and_state/srt_verification_state.json, in this project's translator repository, which is not public. The run covered 287 films in all: these 189, plus 96 that are still in the catalogue but now have a "Subtitles" file instead -- their screenplay file is gone, so nothing below describes the file you would download for them -- plus 2 no longer in the catalogue at all. Only the first group is counted below.

📊 Quality Score

We don't publish a quality score yet: the only automatic benchmark available uses machine-made reference translations, so it measures consistency, not quality. Ratings from a native Lao reader will be summarised here when they exist.

📺 How to Use These Subtitles

These steps are for "Subtitles" files. A "Translated screenplay" file is for reading: its timing is synthetic, so it will not line up with a video.

  1. Download: click a film's 🇱🇦 Lao SRT button above (on a "Translated screenplay" card it reads 🇱🇦 Lao script (SRT)), or 🇺🇸/🇱🇦 Bilingual for the English-and-Lao file.
  2. Rename: rename the .srt so its name matches your video file exactly (e.g. 2001.A.Space.Odyssey.1968.mkv & 2001.A.Space.Odyssey.1968.srt).
  3. Play: Open in VLC, Plex, MPV, IINA, or PotPlayer — Lao subtitles will display automatically.
  4. Timing: "Subtitles" files keep the timing of the English subtitle file they were translated from. That file may have been timed for a different release of the film, so lines can run early or late -- use your player's subtitle-delay keys to shift them. "Translated screenplay" files have synthetic, evenly-spaced timing and will not line up with a video at all. In VLC that is G (earlier) and H (later).
